faq.heading: Current limits for Seedance video watermark workflows

items.question: Which video formats are supported?
items.answer: None yet. Direct video upload is not implemented.

items.question: Can I upload a frame from a Seedance video?
items.answer: Yes, if it is JPG, PNG, or WebP, no larger than 10 MB, and you own or may edit the source.

items.question: Will audio or motion be preserved?
items.answer: The current image workflow does not process video, audio, timing, or motion.
